entities.summary: Yacoub Shaheen is a Palestinian musician and singer. Born in Bethlehem, Shaheen grew up surrounded by music from an early age, and engaged in musical lessons from his youth. His early experiences in musical education would inspire him to pursue a career as a singer, performing at various festivals and winning competitions.
